structured.reason: If any candidate is unblocked, the shortest wait is 0.0, so the shortest-wait set equals the unblocked set. The forced else-branch therefore passes resolve the same preferred keys. Unblocked credentials are still chosen and rotated before blocked ones, assuming the limiter reports 0.0, never a negative value, for unblocked keys.
sources: Automatic key selection shall choose an unblocked credential before a blocked credential.
